evidence.claim: Joko Widodo and Ma'ruf Amin were formally inaugurated for the 2019-2024 presidential term.
evidence.title: Presiden Joko Widodo dan Wakil Presiden Ma'ruf Amin Dilantik di MPR
evidence.excerpt: Joko Widodo and Ma'ruf Amin were formally inaugurated for the 2019-2024 presidential term.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official presidency site with a dated inauguration notice and direct officeholder identification.
evidence.period_fit: Establishes Jokowi's office during the 2022 period.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct attribution to Jokowi as officeholder; this is office status, not policy performance.

evidence.claim: The President serves a five-year term with only one reelection, is supreme commander of the armed forces, and may declare war, make peace, and conclude treaties with DPR approval.
evidence.title: Indonesia 1945 (reinst. 1959, rev. 2002) Constitution
evidence.excerpt: The President serves a five-year term with only one reelection, is supreme commander of the armed forces, and may declare war, make peace, and conclude treaties with DPR approval.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Constitutional text directly fixes the term ceiling and the treaty/war powers relevant to existential-risk exposure.
evidence.period_fit: Defines the 2022 ceiling and the absence of open-ended tenure or nuclear command authority.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct institutional authority; Jokowi had war/treaty powers only within constitutional approval rules.
contrary_evidence: Indonesia is not a nuclear-armed state, so these powers do not translate into nuclear-use authority.

evidence.claim: Indonesia, speaking on behalf of NAM, reaffirmed the need for multilateral nuclear disarmament, supported CTBT, and emphasized that nuclear-weapon-free zones strengthen nonproliferation.
evidence.title: Dangers Posed by Nuclear Weapons Back in Global Spotlight, United Nations High Representative for Disarmament Affairs Tells First Committee
evidence.excerpt: Indonesia, speaking on behalf of NAM, reaffirmed the need for multilateral nuclear disarmament, supported CTBT, and emphasized that nuclear-weapon-free zones strengthen nonproliferation.
evidence.source_locator: Indonesia (on behalf of the Non-Aligned Movement) statement
evidence.source_confidence_reason: UN meeting record captures a dated official statement from the Indonesian delegation.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attribution is to Indonesia's delegation, not a direct Jokowi statement; still useful as state posture context.
contrary_evidence: This is diplomatic posture, not evidence of a ruler-level command or crisis choice in 2022.

evidence.claim: Indonesia told the First Committee that nuclear-weapon states should comply with their obligations, eliminate arsenals transparently, and that nuclear safety and security norms should be pursued within the IAEA framework.
evidence.title: Non-Nuclear-Armed States Get Nothing in Return for Fulfilling Commitments Except Threat of Potential Annihilation, First Committee Told
evidence.excerpt: Indonesia told the First Committee that nuclear-weapon states should comply with their obligations, eliminate arsenals transparently, and that nuclear safety and security norms should be pursued within the IAEA framework.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: UN meeting record preserves the statement and its policy content directly.
evidence.ruler_attribution: State-level foreign-policy line rather than direct presidential choice.
contrary_evidence: Again, this is a multilateral statement, not evidence of Jokowi personally managing a nuclear crisis.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said peace and stability are key to global recovery and that Indonesia's G20 presidency was pushing for a peaceful settlement of the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
evidence.title: President Jokowi: Peace, Stability are Key to Global Economic Recovery
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said peace and stability are key to global recovery and that Indonesia's G20 presidency was pushing for a peaceful settlement of the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official presidential-cabinet statement with dated remarks and direct attribution.
evidence.period_fit: Directly in-period and tied to Jokowi's G20 diplomacy in 2022.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct to Jokowi as G20 chair and president; this is his public diplomatic posture, not an inherited baseline claim.
contrary_evidence: It is a diplomatic statement, not proof of operational conflict restraint by itself.

evidence.claim: Jokowi was to meet leaders of Ukraine and Russia to advocate peace and help ease the food crisis, and the trip was described as the first such visit by an Asian leader.
evidence.title: G20 president Indonesia seeks to ease crisis with Ukraine, Russia visits
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi was to meet leaders of Ukraine and Russia to advocate peace and help ease the food crisis, and the trip was described as the first such visit by an Asian leader.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting is strong independent corroboration, though carried through a syndication mirror.
evidence.period_fit: Matches the lead-up to Jokowi's June 2022 Ukraine-Russia mission.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly about Jokowi's planned mission and foreign-policy choice as G20 chair.
contrary_evidence: This is reporting about a planned mission, not the mission's complete results by itself.

evidence.claim: Jokowi emphasized respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, said peace must be sought, offered to carry Zelenskyy's message to Putin, and pledged humanitarian assistance and support for hospital reconstruction and food-export security.
evidence.title: Joint Press Statement of President of the Republic of Indonesia and President of Ukraine, at the Mariinsky Palace, Kyiv, Ukraine, June 29, 2022
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi emphasized respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, said peace must be sought, offered to carry Zelenskyy's message to Putin, and pledged humanitarian assistance and support for hospital reconstruction and food-export security.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct official transcript from the presidential secretariat with precise dated language.
evidence.period_fit: Exact target-period evidence for June 2022 international conduct.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct personal attribution to Jokowi; this was his diplomatic action and public position.
contrary_evidence: The statement is peace-oriented and does not show whether the effort changed battlefield conditions.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said peace and humanitarian issues were Indonesia's foreign-policy priority, that dialogue should remain open, that he was ready to be a bridge of communication, and that food and fertilizer supply chains needed urgent restoration with UN support.
evidence.title: Pernyataan Pers Bersama Presiden RI dan Presiden Rusia, di Moskow, Rusia, 30 Juni 2022
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said peace and humanitarian issues were Indonesia's foreign-policy priority, that dialogue should remain open, that he was ready to be a bridge of communication, and that food and fertilizer supply chains needed urgent restoration with UN support.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct official transcript of Jokowi's post-meeting remarks in Moscow.
evidence.period_fit: Exact 2022 conduct during his Russia visit.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct personal attribution to Jokowi and his stated mission to Putin.
contrary_evidence: This is a self-described peace mission; it does not prove Russian agreement or concrete settlement terms.

evidence.claim: Jokowi refused Ukraine's request for military support and said Indonesia would send humanitarian assistance instead, while continuing support for peace negotiations.
evidence.title: Jokowi seeks to 'unite' G20 in talks with Ukraine, Russia
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi refused Ukraine's request for military support and said Indonesia would send humanitarian assistance instead, while continuing support for peace negotiations.
evidence.source_locator: final paragraph describing the refusal of military support and humanitarian alternative
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent national reporting on a specific ruler decision, consistent with official statements.
evidence.period_fit: In-period and directly relevant to Jokowi's response to a wartime request.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct to Jokowi as the decision-maker responding to Zelenskyy's request.
contrary_evidence: The article is a report, not a verbatim official transcript of the refusal itself.

evidence.claim: Indonesia said the military attack on Ukraine was unacceptable, called for a peaceful resolution through dialogue and diplomacy, insisted on respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, and urged safe passage for humanitarian aid and civilians.
evidence.title: United Nations Stands with People of Ukraine, Secretary-General Tells General Assembly, Stressing 'Enough Is Enough', Fighting Must Stop, as Emergency Session Gets Under Way
evidence.excerpt: Indonesia said the military attack on Ukraine was unacceptable, called for a peaceful resolution through dialogue and diplomacy, insisted on respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, and urged safe passage for humanitarian aid and civilians.
evidence.source_locator: Indonesia statement in the meeting coverage
evidence.source_confidence_reason: UN meeting record captures the Indonesian delegate's statement contemporaneously and verbatim enough for attribution.
evidence.period_fit: Exact March 2022 crisis response, before the Kyiv/Moscow mission.
evidence.ruler_attribution: State-level foreign-policy posture attributable to Indonesia, with Jokowi as president and G20 chair.
contrary_evidence: This is a diplomatic statement rather than direct command of military forces.

evidence.claim: Indonesia voted in favor of the General Assembly resolution demanding Russia end its use of force and withdraw from Ukraine.
evidence.title: Aggression against Ukraine : resolution / adopted by the General Assembly
evidence.excerpt: Indonesia voted in favor of the General Assembly resolution demanding Russia end its use of force and withdraw from Ukraine.
evidence.source_locator: vote list showing INDONESIA as Y
evidence.source_confidence_reason: UN voting record is authoritative for the state vote and date.
evidence.period_fit: Early 2022 wartime response during Jokowi's term.
evidence.ruler_attribution: State vote, not a personal speech, but still attributable to Jokowi's government at the UN.
contrary_evidence: A yes vote is a state posture and does not by itself prove deeper operational peace leadership.

evidence.claim: Indonesia said it was deeply concerned about the humanitarian situation and Bucha reports, called for an independent investigation and objective, transparent procedures, and abstained from the vote.
evidence.title: General Assembly Adopts Text to Suspend Russian Federation from Human Rights Council, Continuing Emergency Special Session on Humanitarian Crisis in Ukraine
evidence.excerpt: Indonesia said it was deeply concerned about the humanitarian situation and Bucha reports, called for an independent investigation and objective, transparent procedures, and abstained from the vote.
evidence.source_locator: Indonesia statement in the press release
evidence.source_confidence_reason: UN press coverage preserves both the reasoning and the vote outcome for Indonesia.
evidence.period_fit: In-period and directly relevant to Jokowi's response to the Ukraine crisis.
evidence.ruler_attribution: State-level position; the abstention shows caution and process concerns under Jokowi's government.
contrary_evidence: Abstention can be read as procedural caution rather than clear condemnation, so it is weaker than a yes vote.

evidence.claim: Indonesia supported the UN resolution condemning Russia's annexation of Ukrainian regions and said the position followed respect for national integrity and international law.
evidence.title: Indonesia dukung resolusi PBB mengutuk pencaplokan Ukraina oleh Rusia
evidence.excerpt: Indonesia supported the UN resolution condemning Russia's annexation of Ukrainian regions and said the position followed respect for national integrity and international law.
evidence.source_locator: opening paragraphs and quoted foreign-ministry explanation
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous local-language reporting on Indonesia's UN stance, with direct foreign-ministry explanation.
evidence.period_fit: Exact 2022 escalation phase after annexation moves.
evidence.ruler_attribution: State-level posture under Jokowi's presidency, with direct relevance to his foreign-policy line.
contrary_evidence: This is a state vote and ministry explanation, not a direct presidential speech.

evidence.claim: Jokowi repeated that leaders must stop the war because war only hurts people and blocks global economic recovery.
evidence.title: Remarks of President of the Republic of Indonesia During Third Session of G20 Summit on Digital Transformation, at The Apurva Kempinski Hotel, Badung Regency, Bali Province, November 16, 2022
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi repeated that leaders must stop the war because war only hurts people and blocks global economic recovery.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official summit transcript with direct ruler attribution and clear date.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct to Jokowi as G20 host and chair.
contrary_evidence: This is summit rhetoric, but it is backed by the concrete diplomatic process and declaration below.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said the G20 leaders agreed to condemn the war in Ukraine because it violated borders and territorial integrity, and he framed the declaration as a major success of Indonesia's presidency.
evidence.title: Indonesian G20 Presidency Produces Bali Leaders' Declaration
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said the G20 leaders agreed to condemn the war in Ukraine because it violated borders and territorial integrity, and he framed the declaration as a major success of Indonesia's presidency.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official presidency transcript with direct attribution and clear policy content.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct personal and institutional attribution to Jokowi as host of the summit.
contrary_evidence: A G20 declaration is a multilateral outcome, not solely a personal achievement.

evidence.claim: Reuters reported that the G20 unanimously adopted a declaration condemning the war in Ukraine, that the declaration said the use or threat of nuclear weapons was inadmissible, and that Jokowi said the war had violated borders and integrity.
evidence.title: Russia's war in Ukraine dominates G20 summit, with leaders agreeing to differ
evidence.excerpt: Reuters reported that the G20 unanimously adopted a declaration condemning the war in Ukraine, that the declaration said the use or threat of nuclear weapons was inadmissible, and that Jokowi said the war had violated borders and integrity.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting is strong independent corroboration of the summit outcome and Jokowi's remarks.
evidence.period_fit: Exact summit-period corroboration of the Indonesia-led G20 process.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly relevant to Jokowi as host; the declaration is multilateral but his summit leadership is clear.
contrary_evidence: This is independently reported but still centered on a multilateral document, not a unilateral ruler act.
